sourceReview.reason: Exact Coindoo article and a direct primary announcement for the claimed Ant/DBS purchase of tokenized funds could not be retrieved. DBS primary release dated 2026-11-16 concerns cross-border tokenized deposit transfers with Kinexys, not purchases of tokenized funds; earlier Ant tokenized fund activity involved HSBC/Franklin Templeton in October and Amundi/CACEIS in June. Do not conflate these events. Retry no sooner than six hours after reviewedAt.
